user_story: As a user, I want to update multiple fields of a task in a single request so that I can edit efficiently.

positive.title: Successfully update multiple fields of a task
steps: Login to the application with valid credentials
Send a request with valid data to update multiple fields such as title, description, and due date
positive.expected_result: Task fields are updated successfully and reflect the new data provided.

negative.title: Attempt to update task fields with invalid data
steps: Login to the application with valid credentials
Send a request with invalid data (e.g., invalid date format, empty required fields) for multiple fields
negative.expected_result: The system rejects the update request and provides error messages indicating the invalid fields.

edge.title: Update multiple fields with maximum allowable data size
steps: Login to the application with valid credentials
Send a request with data at maximum allowable size (e.g., max length for text fields) to update multiple fields
edge.expected_result: Task fields are updated successfully without performance issues, and the application handles maximum data sizes gracefully.
